title: iliamna rivularis subsp. cismontana
intro: Iliamna rivularis subsp. cismontana, commonly known as Western Iliamna, is a plant species that belongs to the family Thelypodiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral effects, that can aid in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Western Iliamna include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
